{{Infobox |eng = Winter Root |source = [[Hoes|Tilling]] • [[Winter Seeds]] • [[Slimes|Blue Slimes]] |xp = *[[Hoes|Tilling]]: 0 *[[Winter Seeds]]: 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] *[[Slimes|Blue Slimes]]: 0 |season = Winter |edibility = 10 |sellprice = 70 |color = Orange }} The '''Winter Root''' is a [[foraging]] item found only in [[Winter]]. Wild winter roots do not grow above ground, but instead they are buried in the snow/dirt and must be dug up with a [[Hoes|Hoe]] (no other tools, even [[Crafting#Bombs|Bombs]], will work). The highest chance of finding a Winter Root (17-24%, map-dependent) is when digging up an [[Artifact Spot]]. There is also a 4% chance of finding a Winter Root when digging standard tillable soil in any exterior location. Exceptions are in [[the Farm]], where Winter Roots can be found at artifact spots, but not standard tillable soil, and both [[the Desert]] and [[Ginger Island]], where Winter Roots can not be found at all. Digging up a Winter Root provides no experience. Winter Roots can also be grown from [[Winter Seeds]], in which case they are a standard wild-seed crop: they grow above ground, can be harvested without using a tool, give 7 Foraging XP each, and are affected by the [[Skills#Foraging|Gatherer]] and [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist]] professions. Occasionally they may be sold at the [[Traveling Cart]] or found in [[Garbage Can]]s in [[Winter]]. They may also be dropped by Blue [[Slimes]] (8% chance) in [[The Mines]] (floors 41-79) or [[Secret Woods]]. One Winter Root can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. Putting a Winter Root in a [[Seed Maker]] will generate 1-3 [[Winter Seeds]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Kent,Marnie,Gus,Sandy |dislike=Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Haley,Leo,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus |like=Linus,Leah,Harvey }} ==Bundles== Winter Root is used in the {{Bundle|Winter Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Roots Platter|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ===Crafting=== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Winter Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Wi)]] ||{{Description|Winter Seeds}}
''(Produces 10 Winter Seeds per craft.)'' |{{Name|Crocus|1}}{{Name|Crystal Fruit|1}}{{Name|Snow Yam|1}}{{Name|Winter Root|1}} |[[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging]] Level 7 |{{Price|30}} |} ==Tailoring== Winter Root is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt267.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Orange Bow Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *Winter Root may be randomly requested in [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|140}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. ==Trivia== *Winter Roots are the only winter forageable that can be directly put into the [[Seed Maker]]. ==References== The chance of appearing in an artifact spot is calculated by GameLocation::digUpArtifactSpot. The base chance in code is 30% (0.5*0.6), but the actual chance is lower because artifacts and lost books are checked first and must all fail their checks. The chance of appearing in standard tillable soil is calculated by GameLocation::checkForBuriedItem. ==History== {{History|1.4|Winter Root can no longer be dug up in the Desert in Winter.
